name: document_type
description: The type of each source, judged from its first pages or its leading text.

questions.name: type
questions.instructions: What type of source is this document?

choices.periodical_or_newspaper: A newspaper, magazine, journal or other serial.
choices.manuscript_or_letter: A handwritten text, such as a letter, diary or notebook.
choices.account_book_or_ledger: An account book, ledger, payroll or other book of accounts.
choices.register_or_list: A register, census, inventory, catalogue or other list of records.
choices.printed_form_or_ephemera: A printed form, price current, tariff, bill, poster or other ephemera.
